purpose: Teach: 加地/今春/新選/正門/Ａ子/坂井/当地/親方

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと加地家のお祝いに行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I hear you're going with Daddy to the Kaji family's celebration.
lines.style: Warm settling-in tone. Brisk mom-energy softened for her son, a smile behind it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「今春卒業の従兄」のお祝いをしたよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Daddy celebrated for my cousin who's graduating this spring!
lines.style: Quiet pride, phrase-by-phrase pacing, glancing up for approval at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「新選組のドラマを観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, 'Let's watch that drama about the Shinsengumi.'
lines.style: Light, amused relay of Dad's plan, a fond half-laugh under the quote.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと学校の正門で待ち合わせしたよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Daddy met up at the school's front gate!
lines.style: Simple happy report, a little faster than his usual pace, the memory still fresh.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「小説でＡ子と書かれた登場人物」のお話をして下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me all about that character who's written as 'A-ko' in the novel.
lines.style: Softly intrigued, slowing over the odd detail, sharing grown-up news made small for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお友達の坂井おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Daddy met his friend, Mister Sakai!
lines.style: Bright and matter-of-fact, small careful emphasis on the grown-up's name, pleased to know it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「当地の特産品を紹介してもらおう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, 'Let's have them show us the local specialties there.'
lines.style: Cozy planning-ahead warmth, the quote delivered with gentle anticipation, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと相撲の親方インタビュー観たよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Daddy watched an interview with a sumo stablemaster!
lines.style: Eager finish, words tumbling slightly, saving his best report for last.
